_comment: Reference registry for the learning pages. Only entries with status 'verified' may be cited; the build fails otherwise. 'verified' means the full text was read and the bibliographic details confirmed from the document itself. 'crosschecked' means details corroborated from a verified source's reference list but the document itself was not read. 'candidate' means from memory, not yet checked.
